default_profile.description: Name of the profile used by default. Must match a key under [profiles].

theme.description: UI theme id: muted_slate (default), dawn, matrix, nord, tokyo_night, dracula, gruvbox_dark, monokai, or a custom theme file stem from ~/.zentra/themes/.

output_dir.description: Base directory for pentest run artifacts. Blank/unset = <Documents>/Zentra.

profiles.description: Provider profiles keyed by name. A profile name containing '.' MUST be quoted, e.g. [profiles."ag-glm5.1"] — otherwise TOML treats the dot as table nesting and the file fails to load.

base_url.description: API base URL (http/https). For claude_cli/codex_cli this holds the binary name/path instead of a URL.

keyless.description: True for CLI subscription providers (no API key required).
